subject: Trainee / Junior Irrigation Designer application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Cadsult team,

I'm applying for the Trainee / Junior Irrigation Designer role in Perth, advertised on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, reviewing drawings and doing site inspections and quality checks. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I'm open to discussing a move to Perth.

Your advert offers mentoring toward the Certified Irrigation Designer qualification, and I'd like to build on my drainage design work that way. I haven't designed irrigation systems yet, and my AutoCAD work so far is from study.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

subject: Infrastructure Engineer application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Vincenzo,

I've applied through Council's online system for the Infrastructure Engineer role advertised on SEEK, and your advert named you for questions, so I wanted to reach you directly as well.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, doing site inspections, quality checks and progress reports. I'm based in Melton with a White Card, a driver's licence and full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I'm open to discussing a move to Sydney.

The mix of operational and capital works, from site investigation through to delivery, is the start I'm after. I haven't managed contracts or prepared tender documents yet.

Would you have ten minutes for a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
